Stop repeating test counts in AGENTS.md

The counts there (120 and 42) had gone stale. The README's Quality checks holds the counts (checked today: data layer 136,
app 66, collector 9); AGENTS.md now points there.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 Extra <noreply@anthropic.com>

Say in the README that building with run_on_device.sh is the main way to install

The Installing section led with the unsigned .ipa from a release, but the way the author installs, and the one the project
supports first, is building from source with tools/run_on_device.sh. It now comes first with the steps, and the .ipa route is
second, with a note that it has only been checked for its contents. docs/run-on-iphone.md no longer says "already done on
this Mac". Version 0.6.2.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Move Language under Behavior and write the Japanese with full-width commas and periods

The language choice sits in the Behavior section, next to the link to iOS Settings for language and location, instead
of at the top of Settings. The Japanese text of the app (the catalog and the permission message) uses the full-width
comma and period, as the author writes Japanese; a test keeps the other forms out. Version 0.6.1.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Choose the app's language in Settings: system default, English or Japanese

Settings > Language switches the whole app at once, without a restart. LanguageState holds the chosen language, its
locale (the language with the phone's region, so units and 12/24 hours keep following the phone) and its translation
bundle; every string built in code goes through L10n.string, and the root view puts the locale into the environment for
SwiftUI text. "System default" follows what iOS gives the app, including its per-app language. The choice is one more
setting, stored on the phone only; settings saved before it existed load as system default.

Tests: language resolution, the locale, lookups in both languages, old and odd saved settings, every catalog entry having a
Japanese translation with the same format specifiers (one key with unescaped percent signs was fixed), and a check that
no code under App/ uses String(localized:) or NSLocalizedString, which would ignore the choice. Version 0.6.0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Version 0.5.2: the first build that carries the licence texts

The 0.5.1 build has no Settings > Licences screen, so its binary would not come with the licence texts that BSD and
Apache require. 0.5.2 adds them (and the copyright holder's full name); the release .ipa is built from this version.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Say how to install the unsigned release build

The release gets an unsigned .ipa with a checksum, to be signed with the reader's own Apple ID by a sideloading tool.
The README gives the check, the two tools, and the limits that are reported for a free Apple ID, labelled as reports
and not as Apple's documentation. Building from source stays as the second way.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Open a licence text from its row

Tapping a row in Settings > Licences left a blank page: a value-based link had no destination it could use, because the
Settings sheet already reaches this screen through its own link. Each row now carries its own destination.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
